theme: Where to put the active sites on a surface
title: Placing Active Sites Along a Diffusion-Fed Strip
strategies: trivial: pack all B sites into one contiguous block centered in the strip -- the checker's own reference construction

greedy: split the budget between the two boundary reservoirs and pack each half as a contiguous block touching its reservoir ('put sites where the reactant enters') -- ignores both the crowding penalty between adjacent sites and the diffusion-limited starvation of any dense cluster's interior

strong: estimate the diffusion length from D and v_max, then search a handful of evenly-spaced lattice placements at strides/offsets scaled around that length (plus a plain uniform partition), scoring each with an internal copy of the exact reaction-diffusion-poisoning protocol and keeping the best -- exploits the insight that spacing sites near the diffusion length trades nominal site count for much higher per-site turnover
invalid: every position activated (L ones, count = L > B for all instances) -> budget exceeded, rejected before scoring
